arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.city = 'Rome' AND ml.state = 'GA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions at merchant locations in Rome, Georgia (state code GA), over the full data period.
assumptions: Georgia means the US state (state code 'GA'), not the country Georgia.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, including negative amounts and ones with errors.
The count covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
